scope: Per-image identity of the firmware in the official Fairphone FP6 factory packages that DiamaneOS tracks. Read from the archives only; nothing here was read from a phone. See docs/FIRMWARE.md.

stock_flash_script.requires: fastboot oem device-info reporting both "Device unlocked: true" and "Device critical unlocked: true"
stock_flash_script.slot_handling: writes both _a and _b of every A/B partition, then selects slot a

avb_rollback_index.meaning: security patch date as Unix time (2026-08-05 and 2026-09-05, 00:00 UTC)

rollback.qualcomm_anti_rollback_version: OEM metadata anti-rollback version 1 in every signed firmware image of both builds; QTI metadata version 0 where present. Unchanged.

NON-HLOS.bin.role: modem partition: MPSS modem, ADSP, CDSP, WPSS Wi-Fi (qca6750), IPA and trusted apps

pvmfw.img.diamaneos_source: DiamaneOS builds pvmfw from source (PRODUCT_BUILD_PVMFW_IMAGE) and ships it in its own OTA

NON-HLOS.bin.role: modem partition: MPSS modem, ADSP, CDSP, WPSS Wi-Fi (qca6750), IPA and trusted apps

pvmfw.img.diamaneos_source: DiamaneOS builds pvmfw from source (PRODUCT_BUILD_PVMFW_IMAGE) and ships it in its own OTA

changes_from_previous.BTFM.bin: filesystem metadata only (all 11 contained files byte-identical)
changes_from_previous.NON-HLOS.bin: contents changed: modem, ADSP and CDSP code/data segments differ with unchanged version strings; WPSS Wi-Fi, IPA and trusted apps re-signed only; 14 carrier MCFG profiles (1&1, Orange, Proximus, AT&T) and the 3 modem_pr/so images changed content; 152 other signed files re-signed only
changes_from_previous.XblRamdump.elf: rebuilt (code/data segments differ; same Qualcomm version string)
changes_from_previous.abl.elf: rebuilt (code/data segments differ; same Qualcomm version string)
changes_from_previous.devcfg.mbn: rebuilt (code/data segments differ; same Qualcomm version string)
changes_from_previous.dspso.bin: one contained file changed (adsp/sns_tppe.so) plus the filesystem journal
changes_from_previous.multi_image.mbn: rebuilt (code/data segments differ; same Qualcomm version string)
changes_from_previous.pvmfw.img: rebuilt (not used: DiamaneOS builds its own pvmfw)
